question: Garf-san is 14 years old, so he was separated from his older sister more than ten years ago, right? In Lugunica, is it normal for a 3 or 4 year old child to be using a shield in a mock fight? Are the two of them just special?
answer: Not the two of them so much as Garf is special. Also, part of the problem is that there aren’t any toys in Sanctuary. Getting blown away by Frederica was about the only entertainment. Even in Lugunica, ones like Garf and Reinhard are unusual.
